requestedProduct: Tnuva 5% plain cottage cheese, standard 250 g tubs

environment.where: GitHub Actions hosted runner (ubuntu, GitHub-hosted IP space)
environment.note: The host restrictions recorded in docs/evidence/tnuva-cottage-cheese-research-20261015.json describe the Codex cloud environment. The Actions runner has direct public HTTPS access; every fetch below was made from the runner with curl and the store's own public endpoints. No proxy, credential, login, order, street address or access-control bypass was used.

policies: tivtaam-cottage-tel-aviv-north-delivery v1 (home delivery ₪29.90, published minimum order ₪300)
yuda-cottage-tel-aviv-home-delivery v1 (home delivery ₪35, published minimum order ₪150)
runtime.note: Both observed listings stay visible as unrankable: every exact 4/6/8/10-tub batch is below each vendor's published minimum order (Tiv Taam ₪300; Super Yuda ₪150), so no standalone batch is purchasable and no delivered total is ranked. The dairy board reports the exact reason per vendor.

sources.name: Tiv Taam (טיב טעם), online branch 924 Ramat HaHayal

product.priceNote: The API returns two rows for the same catalog product: the sellable active row at ₪6.10 (id 5662070, isActive true, isVisible true, isOutOfStock false) and a hidden inactive row at ₪5.70 (id 1521501). The adapter selects the sellable row and never prices the hidden one.
product.stockEvidence: branch.isOutOfStock=false together with isActive=true and isVisible=true; this is the store's own branch flag, not a price-only scrape.
product.purchaseCapEvidence: The public anonymous cart API accepted 10 tubs of this listing without a quantity-limit warning (total 10 × ₪6.10 = ₪61.00); no per-line cap was observed up to the largest requested batch. The site does not publish a numeric cap for this item.

delivery.areaEndpointNote: Each area was read from the public endpoint /v2/retailers/1062/branches/924/areas/<id> on 2026-10-15; the branch list endpoint /v2/retailers/1062/branches?isOnline=true was used to confirm that branch 924 is the online delivery branch and to enumerate its areas.
delivery.coverage: Part of Tel Aviv–Yafo (ת״א צפון: רמת אביב, רמת החייל, אפקה) plus Ramat HaSharon, Ramat Gan, Bnei Brak, Herzliya and Rosh HaAyin. Jaffa and other parts of Tel Aviv–Yafo are outside the published areas; the site treats the default locality as covered with this caveat.

minimumOrder.source: https://htmlcache.blob.core.windows.net/html-production-env/r-1062/desktop/multi-true/data.js (retailer config minimumOrderPrice: "300") and the published site terms clause 16.1: "סכום המינימום להזמנה הינו 300 ₪" (the minimum order amount is ₪300). Clause 16 also says Tiv Taam need not supply orders whose total is not above the minimum.

delivery.robots: https://www.tivtaam.co.il/robots.txt: Crawl-delay 4; /cart*, /user* and /search* disallowed; the product API and the catalogProduct page are not disallowed. The adapter declares crawlDelayMs 4000.

anonymousCartQuotes.method: Public anonymous cart API: POST /v2/retailers/1062/branches/924/carts with {"lines":[{"retailerProductId":5662070,"quantity":N,"type":1}]}, then POST /carts/<id>/delivery-line {areaId:2446, deliveryTypeIds:[1]} and PATCH /carts/<id> {deliveryProduct:true, deliveryProduct_Id:1966627, deliveryType:1}. No login, street address, payment or order submission; the checkout itself requires login and was not entered.
anonymousCartQuotes.minimumWarning: The anonymous cart API did not show a minimum-order warning, but the checkout requires login and the published ₪300 minimum order is the vendor's own binding condition, so every standalone batch is below the minimum and is not ranked.

sources.name: Super Yuda (סופר יודה), branch 2481 ישעיהו, Tel Aviv–Yafo (one of three published online Tel Aviv branches)

product.priceNote: Branch 2481 returned one row: regularPrice ₪6.70, isActive true, isVisible true, isOutOfStock false. Hidden Tel Aviv rows (branch 2441 בארט ₪5.70 and branch 2483 נחלת בנימין ₪6.70, both isVisible false) are never priced. Branches 2480 אינשטיין and 2485 בן ציון priced the same ₪6.70 with the same delivery terms.
product.stockEvidence: branch.isOutOfStock=false together with isActive=true and isVisible=true; this is the store's own branch flag, not a price-only scrape.
product.purchaseCapEvidence: The product API publishes quantityLimit 999 per line for this listing, far above the largest requested batch. A public anonymous cart create call accepted a 10-tub line without a limit warning, but the store's Radware WAF served a bot challenge for the cart PATCH/GET reads, so no cart total was read and no cart quote is claimed.

delivery.coverage: Three published online Tel Aviv–Yafo branch areas (ישעיהו, אינשטיין, בן ציון), each delivering only inside its own polygon; coverage outside those areas is not established. Jaffa and other parts of Tel Aviv–Yafo outside the polygons are not covered.

minimumOrder.source: Retailer config settings.minimumOrderPrice "150" plus each area's deliveryMinimumCost 150 (https://htmlcache.blob.core.windows.net/html-production-env/r-1492/desktop/multi-true/data.js and the public areas endpoint), both read from the runner on 2026-10-15.

delivery.robots: https://www.yuda.co.il/robots.txt: Crawl-delay 4; /search*, /cart*, /user*, /account*, /coupons*, /orders-history* disallowed; the product API path and the catalogProduct page are not disallowed. The adapter declares crawlDelayMs 4000.
delivery.wafLimitation: Storefront HTML pages and cart PATCH/GET requests return the store's Radware bot challenge to the runner (captcha.perfdrive.com). The public product and areas endpoints answered normally. No challenge was bypassed; the adapter uses only the unchallenged public endpoints and does not claim a cart quote.

From the runner, only tivtaam.co.il, yuda.co.il, superdosh.co.il, duchan.co.il, freshmarket.co.il, superhaviv.co.il and superalonit.co.il answered without a challenge; every other storefront (including twinsmarket.co.il, sholik.net, verona-market.co.il, mck.co.il, hinam-plus.com, keshet-teamim.co.il, victoryonline.co.il, carrefour.co.il, quik.co.il and the shopo.co.il stores) returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' or Radware challenge for both HTML and API paths. No reachable permitted vendor can deliver an exact 4-10 tub batch to Tel Aviv–Yafo because every reachable vendor's published minimum order exceeds the batch item total; the low-minimum chains are blocked by bot protection or vendor terms.
